_comment: The one place CI names a toolchain version or a runner image. Workflows never write these themselves: the setup-toolchain action (.github/actions/setup-toolchain) reads this file, and the jobs that run on macOS read `macos` through their Relevance job's output, because `runs-on` cannot read a file. scripts/check-toolchain-pins.ts fails a workflow that hardcodes one. Bump a value here and every build moves together.
macosNote: arm64 standard image (macos-26-intel is the Intel one). macos-14 was retired 2026-11-02. When this image is announced for retirement, change this one value.
gradleNote: AGP 8.9.3 requires Gradle 8.11.1 or later. Gradle is provisioned by gradle/actions/setup-gradle, not the checked-in wrapper, so the CI toolchain stays explicit.
bunNote: Exact, not latest: a new Bun release cannot change what CI builds until this line changes.
rustNote: Exact, not stable: the toolchain is installed with rustup, which ships on every runner image, so a stale image cannot change what is built.
armGccNote: Pinned so a toolchain change is a reviewable commit. Must satisfy the NP_ARM_GCC_MIN_VERSION 12.3 gate in firmware/cmake/arm-none-eabi.cmake.
